intro.name: Viktor Nešić
intro.offer: Viktor Nešić is a senior mobile developer building native iOS, Android and Kotlin Multiplatform apps with Swift, SwiftUI, UIKit, Kotlin and Jetpack Compose. Available for freelance and contract projects, working remotely.

caseStudy.title: DigitalPass
caseStudy.lead: A digital pass prototype for Android: accounts and passes backed by signed JWT credentials, decoded on the device, with live expiry countdowns, online status and credential renewal.

brief.title: The brief
text: A prototype for passes whose validity comes from signed credentials rather than a printed card.

contributions.title: What I did
items: Built the Android prototype in Java with Volley.
Fetched time and pass credentials as JWTs from a backend and decoded them on the device.
Showed live countdowns to expiry, online or offline status, and let users renew their credentials.

team.title: Team
team.text: I built the app myself, working directly with the client.

outcome.title: The result
outcome.text: A working prototype of credential-backed passes with live expiry.
